questions.question: Find all real solutions to x² + 6x + 13 = 0.
questions.explanation: Use discriminant: b² - 4ac = 6² - 4(1)(13) = 36 - 52 = -16 < 0. Negative discriminant means no real solutions.

questions.question: If the roots of 2x² + bx + 3 = 0 are r and s, and r + s = -5, find b.
questions.explanation: By Vieta's formulas, sum of roots = -b/a. So -b/2 = -5 ⇒ -b = -10 ⇒ b = 10.
